reasons.correctness: The derived query findByActiveFalseAndLastUpdateTimeBefore, purgeInactiveOlderThan returning the count, and the cron job with enabled/days/cron defaults all match the interface. The disabled path returns and failures are logged. 4/4 hidden and 65/65 existing tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: InactiveFaqPurgeCronJob has @SchedulerLock(name="faq:inactivePurge"), a cron from ${support.faq.purge.cron}, @Value enabled:true and @RequiredArgsConstructor constructor injection. It lives in the faq feature package, config is in application.yml, and unit tests were run.
reasons.design_fit: The job only delegates to FaqService and catches failures. The service owns the cutoff logic and the repository owns the derived query. It reuses the existing ShedLock and @Value job pattern from AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob, with no duplicated lookup and a minimal footprint.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest covers the delete count, cutoff computation via ArgumentCaptor and the empty case. InactiveFaqPurgeCronJobUnitTest covers enabled, disabled (verifyNoInteractions) and exception swallowing. Both use MockitoExtension with no Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Before any edit, graph queries found the faq files, their dependents, the TESTED_BY tests and the existing *CronJob examples. The agent then read AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob and its unit test and mirrored their structure.
